name: dynamic-island
title: Dynamic Island
description: A pill that springs open into richer views, in the style of the iPhone status island. The shell animates real size, so content is never distorted.

props.name: view
props.description: Id of the active DynamicIslandView. null shows the compact pill.

props.name: compact
props.description: Pill content, shown when no view is active.

props.name: children
props.description: DynamicIslandView elements. Each one shows when its id matches view.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the shell takes to glide between sizes.
